subject: integration
name: Orivon AI agent
summary: The built-in AI agent: a hidden page and a panel in one pinned bundle, served from a session that cancels any request outside its own origin. Its scripts name no network call (a test fails the build otherwise) and site builds run in a WebAssembly worker with none. It asks LLM_0_1 and, only if allowed, WEB_FETCH_0_1, NAMES_0_2, IPFS_0_2 and SWARM_0_2; each answer comes from the provider the person chose, judged on its own row. It wraps every tool result as untrusted data and checks arguments before any call; the browser, not this page, asks before a write. Judged here by its publisher.
